mission: Search globally for flooded or submerged pyramid contexts and grade them by archaeological evidence, distinguishing actual pyramids with inundated chambers from submerged non-pyramid architecture and visually pyramidal geological claims.

grading.A: confirmed pyramid/royal pyramid complex with documented flooded or underwater interior
grading.B: confirmed submerged archaeological architecture but not demonstrated to be a pyramid
grading.C: human-made submerged structures plausible/partly documented; pyramid identification not established
grading.D: disputed geological/man-made formation or sonar anomaly; pyramid/city claim unconfirmed

matrix.evidence: Peer-reviewed Geoarchaeology study states passages and chambers are submerged; groundwater ingress increased mainly since the late 19th century. A 2024 ERT/TEM study confirms rising groundwater hazard and near-surface archaeological anomalies around the pyramid/labyrinth.
matrix.osiris_relevance: METHOD_CONTROL_ONLY; no source-bound missing-Osiris-member link established.

matrix.evidence: Nuri expedition documents a ca. 100 x 100 ft pyramid with three burial chambers cut beneath it; rising groundwater has submerged the tomb and it is being excavated with underwater archaeological methods.
matrix.osiris_relevance: UNDERWATER_ARCHAEOLOGY_METHOD_CONTROL; not an Osiris relic context.

matrix.site: Giza Osiris Shaft under Khafre causeway
matrix.evidence: Published excavation documents three levels; the lowest chamber was flooded and contains a water-surrounded sarcophagus, published skeletal remains, Osiris amulets and djed-pillar amulets.
matrix.osiris_relevance: HIGH biological/passport control, but OSIRIAN_ARCHITECTURE + HUMAN_REMAINS != OSIRIS.

matrix.evidence: Peer-reviewed work reports a roughly 100 m zigzag stone wall, intact pots, sherds and arrowheads under several metres of water; sediment dating indicates major flooding around the late 1600s CE.
matrix.lima_peru_relevance: Real Peruvian submerged-archaeology node; no Egypt/Osiris connection established.

matrix.evidence: UNESCO reports more than twenty submerged sites and over 20,000 objects; systematic work includes shrines, dwellings, an early port and underwater Tiwanaku ritual offerings.
Submerged urban/temple archaeology is securely established and already cross-linked in CROFT to physical Khoiak ritual machinery.

Investigations documented a long stone wall, pottery and apparently worked stones; Chinese archaeologists cautioned that evidence did not establish a city, and contemporary reporting specifically noted that claims of a small pyramid lacked photographic evidence at that stage.

Side-scan sonar at roughly 600-750 m depth revealed geometric forms; ROV imagery showed scattered limestone blocks including a small pyramid-shaped block. Cuban geologist Manuel Iturralde-Vinent states that popular images of large pyramids are artistic reconstructions and available evidence cannot establish artificial construction or even that the area was once emergent.

Stepped geometry is real, but strong geological interpretations explain it as naturally jointed/eroded sandstone, possibly with limited human modification. It is not accepted as a confirmed ancient pyramid or city.
matrix.promotion_rule: Do not use visual resemblance as archaeological identification.

egypt_water_context.osireion_abydos: Water-filled/water-saturated Osirian architecture with modern isotope/geophysical work indicating mixed groundwater/Nile/paleowater and a prospective paleochannel; not a pyramid.
egypt_water_context.ahramat_branch: 2024 research reconstructs a major extinct Nile branch along the pyramid field and supports water-access/harbor functions for many pyramid causeways; this is ancient hydraulic proximity, not evidence that the pyramids themselves were underwater.

canonical_formula: CLAIM -> PRIMARY_SURVEY -> STRUCTURE_CLASS -> HUMAN_WORK_TEST -> DATE -> SUBMERGENCE_MECHANISM -> OBJECT_CONTEXT -> ONLY_THEN_CULTURAL_INTERPRETATION
canonical_seal: SOME PYRAMIDS REALLY ARE FLOODED. SOME RUINS REALLY ARE UNDERWATER. THE WORD PYRAMID IS ONLY PROMOTED WHEN THE ARCHAEOLOGY, NOT THE SILHOUETTE, EARNS IT.
